name: Kitni Mast Hai Zindagi
overview:
Join the adventures of the lively gang from Excel College – Vir, Mini, Ananya, and KD – as they navigate through the highs and lows of college life. From friendships to love triangles, from exams to parties, this iconic series captures the essence of youth like no other!'

Set against the backdrop of a bustling college campus, ""Kitni Mast Hai Zindagi"" takes you on a rollercoaster ride of emotions, laughter, and love. Will Vir and Mini's friendship turn into something more? Can Ananya find her true calling amidst the chaos? And what antics will KD get up to next?
